root_cause.text: The `invalidate_complete()` function unconditionally attempts to unlock and free `mg->cell` without checking if it is NULL, which can occur when bio prison cell locking fails during concurrent writes in passthrough mode, leaving `mg->cell` uninitialized.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a NULL check (`if (mg->cell)`) before calling `dm_cell_unlock_v2()` and `free_prison_cell()`. The CVE description explicitly states that "when dm-cache starts to invalidate a cache entry and bio prison cell lock fails due to concurrent write to the same cached block, mg->cell remains NULL," and the error path in `invalidate_complete()` was attempting to dereference this NULL pointer unconditionally, causing the null-ptr-deref in `dm_cell_unlock_v2()`.
